Your next level

you think.

AchieveX is a five-week academic championship that brings learning and healthy competition together.

Test your fundamentals, improve your problem-solving, and build confidence through weekly assessments. Every round is a chance to learn, recover, and return stronger.

✧

Learn through experience.
Grow through consistency.

KNOW THE GAME

One championship.
Your own path.

01
◈

Choose your arena.

Junior is for first-year students. Senior is for second-, third-, and fourth-year students, choosing either the Core or CS track. Senior track choices are final after registration.

02
↗

Make every point count.

Five weekly tests. 100 points each. Rankings use cumulative scores and are released weekly with answer keys. Final ties follow the committee’s pre-announced criteria.

03
◎

Come back stronger.

A recovery mechanism will help participants bounce back from missed or low scores. The exact rule will be announced by the organising committee.

04
✦

Earn your spotlight.

Weekly top performers, the Biggest Climber, and Perfect Five attendance receive special recognition. All participants receive participation certificates.

EFFORT DESERVES RECOGNITION

on the board.
